Full Stack Engineer at Mirian AI
Posted 2 months ago
Save
Apply
MIRIAN AI is building the agentic financial operating system for PE-backed mid-market companies. Our AI agents don't just track tasks — they do the actual accounting work: computing accruals, reconciling transactions, generating journal entries, and improving with every close cycle. Humans review and approve.

We're looking for a Founding AI Engineer who can design and build production agentic systems from scratch — not wrappers around ChatGPT, not chatbots, not prompt playgrounds. Real multi-step AI pipelines that handle financial data with precision.

What you'll own:
This is a true full-stack role, balanced across Go and TypeScript. You'll own features from API design and data model to the UI — and the design-driven codegen chain that keeps the contract honest in between. You'll work across three areas:

Backend services & data — Go services behind a design-driven Goa API, PostgreSQL schemas and typed sqlc queries, and event-driven workflows on Kafka.
Frontend product surfaces — Next.js / React interfaces for AR/AP, cash forecasting, reconciliation, and dashboards, consuming the API through generated, end-to-end-typed contracts.
The seams in between — multi-tenant isolation, service-to-service integration with our agentic and workflow services, money correctness, and observability across the stack.
Stack: Golang, PostgreSQL, Message Queues, Next.js, React, Typescript, NodeJS, Docker, Terraform

You should have:

4+ years building and shipping production web applications end-to-end, comfortable owning both server and client.
Strong backend skills in a statically typed language — Go preferred (or strong Java / C# / Rust / TypeScript-backend experience and eagerness to go deep in Go) — building REST APIs and services.
Strong frontend skills with React and TypeScript, and a modern framework (Next.js or equivalent).
Solid relational database fundamentals — schema design, migrations, and writing and optimizing SQL (PostgreSQL preferred).
Experience with API contracts and codegen (OpenAPI, Goa, GraphQL, or similar) and keeping types honest across the boundary.
Familiarity with event-driven / async systems (Kafka, queues, or similar) and the failure modes they bring.
A habit of testing across the stack — backend unit and integration plus frontend unit and e2e.
A correctness mindset for sensitive data — you reach for transactions, idempotency, and careful validation by instinct.
Strong collaboration and written communication — thrives in a design-driven, async, written-first culture alongside PM, design, and engineering.
Bonus points:
Fintech, accounting, or ERP domain knowledge
Prior 0→1 startup experience

Why MIRIAN:
Founding-team ESOPs and impact — shape the product and architecture from day one
$5B+ market dominated by legacy tools with zero agentic AI in production
Remote-friendly, flexible hours
